notice: Nulls are deliberately incomplete. These are field inventories, not valid manifests, signatures, receipts or authorization. Never populate verification booleans from a self-asserted document.

validity.clock: Trusted UTC, explicit evaluation time; missing/expired/future or conflicting evidence blocks clearance

canonicalization: UTF-8 ASCII-escaped JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no NaN, duplicate keys rejected on admission; UTC millisecond-aligned query times; exact schema 1.0; canonicalize manifest through existing model/digest helpers, not raw input bytes
trust: Issuer and verifier independently authenticated and distinct. Verifier trust anchor pinned outside supplied package. Signature envelope/approved authenticated review admission is future work. Hash alone proves neither issuer nor ownership. No secrets or customer payloads in receipts.

ownership.review_criteria: Authoritative isolated development records, exact UUID relationships; no fixtures, model authority or protected ai_soc lookup

active_state.review_criteria: Fresh independent control-plane read; active true and unchanged at admission

source.review_criteria: Exact metadata identity and exclusive synthetic development ownership; names/agent IDs alone insufficient; replacement invalidates receipt

privileges.review_criteria: Independent effective ACL review, no wildcard/write/admin grants; required actions mapped to selected version, no destructive permission probes

credential_isolation.review_criteria: Dedicated development account and delivery boundary; no credential values, key hashes or tokens; no production resolver reuse

tls.review_criteria: Independent CA provenance and exact SAN/chain verification; private key excluded; no insecure fallback

egress.review_criteria: Effective host/VM policy and controlled development-only negative tests; Compose internal flag alone insufficient; no production probes

budgets.review_criteria: Measured bounded behavior using synthetic endpoints; exact-source filtering, one page, no retry, aggregate deadlines and output rejection

issuer_verifier.review_criteria: Authenticated independent verifier validates issuer, integrity and source authority; reject embedded self-supplied trust roots, stale or contradictory receipts
